problem.text: LinearEXL3 declared config as Config even though its constructor never reads or stores that argument.

reasoning.text: The cleanup changes only the annotation to Config | None, making the declared interface agree with the argument's unused status rather than removing a positional parameter.

impact.text: None becomes explicitly permitted by the annotation, but config remains required: no default is added. Tensor validation, initialization and inference code are unchanged.

source_notes.text: Closed issue #11, “AssertionError: bias is wrong datatype,” reports a conversion failure and subsequent successful fix. Its connection here is inferred solely from its traceback naming LinearEXL3.__init__; this annotation-only change does not alter bias handling.

limitations: No repository execution or type-checker validation was performed. This annotation-only change offers no useful numerical computation to validate.
Literal whole-tree searches establish the named construction sites, not dynamic or external callers.

chapters.title: Declare nullable configuration without changing construction

claims.text: LinearEXL3.__init__ changes config: Config to config: Config | None. The constructor does not dereference config or assign self.config; its state comes from dimensions, quantization tensors, bias and output dtype. Accepting None therefore requires no new runtime branch.

Whole-parent-tree search finds two direct construction sites, both in Linear: load_exl3 passes self.config with loaded tensors, and convert_exl3 passes self.config with quantizer outputs and the original bias. Both remain compatible; neither is changed to pass None. Other matches are imports, the class definition and an isinstance check, not additional constructors or subclasses.

Retaining the argument preserves those positional calls while relaxing the declared type. This is interface cleanup, not evidence of a new configuration-free loading workflow: Linear.load_exl3 still reads checkpoint tensors through self.config.stc before construction.
The earlier quantized-inference entry establishes the loading/reconstruction interface and records incomplete packed-sign support in its historical implementation.

That historical Python packed-sign concern is changed in the inspected parent: construction unpacks supplied su/sv into suh/svh and stores su/sv as None, so forward receives unpacked factors and get_weight_tensor avoids truth-testing stored packed tensors. The task leaves this initialization unchanged; this inspection does not validate GPU execution.

annotation.summary: Makes LinearEXL3's unused config argument explicitly nullable without changing its required position, callers or runtime computation.
